correctness.rationale: Apply Definition 2.1 of Fallat et al. with spread before ignition and majority influence at each unburned vertex. If the centre ignites first, the next spread burns all leaves, with colour populations p+1 and q. If a leaf ignites first, the centre necessarily burns in the next spread, and for m>=3 exactly one additional leaf can be ignited before propagation of all remaining leaves. That ignition flips at most one natural leaf colour: for 1<=p<=m-1 optimal class size max(p+2,q+1); the endpoints p=0 and p=m separately give m and m+1. Every signing of the star is switching equivalent, so minimizing gives ceil((m+3)/2); the published coding identity gives covering radius floor((m-1)/2). Independently implemented spread/ignite recursion and exhaustively checked all 504 signings over m=3..8, without using the author verifier, confirming boundary cases. The two-leaf path is excluded explicitly.
